fields.description: Chevalia Fields offers four and five bedroom villas beside the Green Core of Grand Polo Club & Resort. The setting brings homes close to the estate’s equestrian landscape, clubhouse and parks. Five bedroom layouts come in two substantially different size groups, making the precise villa type an important part of any comparison.

overview: The brochure places Chevalia Fields around the estate’s central polo landscape, with three fields, stables and a clubhouse forming its focus. Smaller recreation spaces include pétanque, padel and open lawns. Interiors are described with marble and wood finishes. Facilities shown for the wider estate should be assessed separately from what is included in a particular villa’s sale specification.
research.locationNote: Chevalia Fields sits at the Green Core edge within Grand Polo Club & Resort, Dubai. The developer’s map shows connections towards The Oasis, Expo City and Al Maktoum International Airport. Check the selected plot, outlook and access route rather than assuming every home directly faces a polo field.
research.priceNote: Emaar’s published starting price is AED 7.34 million. This is not a live unit offer or confirmation of availability; request the price and terms for the specific villa selected.
research.paymentNote: The reviewed launch schedule allocates 10% at booking, seven further 10% instalments and 20% at estimated completion. Historical dates are retained for context; confirm the payment position for a purchase now.
research.handoverNote: April 2029 is the estimated construction-completion month in the launch payment sheet, also reported by Property Finder. Current construction progress and contractual handover need confirmation.

facts.label: Launch collection
facts.value: 179 villas in the launch sheet: 72 four bedroom and 107 five bedroom homes. This is the planned mix, not an available-stock count.

facts.label: Launch prices and average plots
facts.value: Four bedroom villas were quoted from AED 7.34 million with 5,584 sq ft average plots; five bedroom villas from AED 9.19 million with 7,013 sq ft average plots. Each plot requires separate confirmation.

facts.label: Suite versus total area
facts.value: Suites measure 3,064.27 sq ft for four bedrooms, 3,881.57–3,891.37 sq ft for five bedroom B types and 6,640.79–6,648.65 sq ft for A types. Totals add balcony and carport areas.

facts.label: Larger five bedroom layouts
facts.value: The A-type drawings show a lift, maid’s and driver’s rooms, separate show and working kitchens, roof lounge, study and a pool with sunken seating. These are layout-specific features, subject to the final sale specification.
